scholarships.title: Future Scientists Scholarship (منحة علماء المستقبل) 2026/2027 — Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and Central Bank of Egypt
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (Egypt), in cooperation with the Central Bank of Egypt

existing.description: A fully funded Egyptian government scholarship for students who have just finished secondary school, awarded by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research with the Central Bank of Egypt. It pays the full cost of study plus accommodation and living expenses at participating national universities until graduation, in nine specialisms that the state designates as priorities. Selection starts from the secondary school total mark with a geographic allocation across governorates, then an admission test. Applications for 2026/2027 ran from 29 August to 4 September 2026 and have closed.
eligibility: Holder of a secondary school certificate from a government school for the 2025/2026 academic year
Beneficiary of the Takaful wa-Karama initiative, or exempted from school fees by the Ministry of Education during the 2025/2026 academic year
Of good conduct and behaviour (حسن السيرة والسلوك)
Not dismissed academically or disciplinarily from any educational institution
Not already in receipt of another scholarship funded by another party in parallel with this scholarship
Must pass the admission test held after preliminary shortlisting
existing.eligibility_summary: Egyptian nationals who are academically distinguished holders of a secondary school certificate from a government school for the 2025/2026 academic year, and who are either beneficiaries of the Takaful wa-Karama initiative or were exempted from school fees by the Ministry of Education during 2025/2026. Applicants must be of good conduct, must not have been dismissed academically or disciplinarily from any educational institution, and must not already hold another scholarship funded by another party in parallel.
benefits: Living and board costs covered for the duration of study until graduation
Covered provided the student continues to meet the scholarship's requirements
coverage: Full coverage of study costs (تغطية كاملة للمصروفات الدراسية)
Living and board costs (تكاليف الإعاشة) for the whole period of study at participating national universities until graduation
requirements: Preliminary shortlisting is done electronically on the basis of the secondary school total score
Geographic distribution applies: allocation by the governorate where the secondary school is located, or the nearest governorate if the requested faculty is not available there
An admission test is held after preliminary shortlisting
Only candidates who pass the admission test are shortlisted to complete the scholarship admission procedures
Applicant must sign an application undertaking together with the parent or guardian
documents: All documents required by the application portal (uploaded electronically)
Signed application undertaking from the student and the parent or guardian
application_method: Apply online through the official Future Scientists Scholarship portal at https://futurescholars.mohesr.gov.eg/
Log in with the national ID number as the username and the password printed on the secondary school completion certificate
Upload all required documents and sign the student and parent undertaking
existing.selection_notes: Students are sorted electronically according to their secondary school total mark to select preliminary candidates, applying the geographic distribution of scholarships across all governorates. After preliminary shortlisting an admission test is run, and only candidates who pass are shortlisted for the scholarship admission procedure.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving Egyptian secondary school leavers from low-income households who are already covered by the Takaful wa-Karama cash-transfer programme or by a Ministry of Education fee exemption.
existing.notes: The scholarship covers nine specialisms: medicine, engineering, computers and artificial intelligence, nursing, veterinary medicine, applied arts, arts and design, agriculture, and tourism, hotels and antiquities. No monetary amount or stipend figure is published; coverage is described in words as full.
existing.duration: Until graduation from the participating national university (الأهلية)
existing.application_period: 2026/2027 academic year; applications opened 11:00 on Saturday 29 August 2026 and were extended to 19:00 on Friday 4 September 2026.
